title: report-feature-status
responsibility: Produces a report-only feature-document status inventory, flagging planned docs with matching complete loops or explicitly verified linked units and identifying missing owner/date evidence.

inputs.name: featureStatusReport.root
inputs.description: Repository root containing feature docs, loop records, unit manifests, and optional evidence history.

inputs.name: featureStatusReport.verifiedUnitIds
inputs.description: Unit IDs independently confirmed by the caller for comparison against each planned document.

inputs.name: linkedUnits.root
inputs.description: Repository root whose unit manifests are scanned for explicit documentation links.

inputs.name: verifiedUnitsInHistory.root
inputs.description: Repository root whose harness-evidence Git ref is queried for passed verification records.

inputs.name: verifiedUnitsInHistory.unitIds
inputs.description: Unit IDs to search for in committed passed verification records; history is only a warning signal, not shipment proof.

outputs.name: featureStatusReport
outputs.type: { documents: number; planned: number; implemented: number; classificationMismatches: { path: string; folderStatus: string; frontmatterStatus: string | undefined }[]; stalePlanned: { path: string; reasons: string[] }[]; missingOwnershipOrDateEvidence: { path: string; fields: string[] }[] }
outputs.description: Counts planned and implemented feature docs, reports folder/frontmatter mismatches, potential stale planned labels, and absent ownership or review-date evidence.

outputs.name: linkedUnits
outputs.description: Map from a feature-document path to unit IDs whose manifests explicitly name that document.

outputs.name: verifiedUnitsInHistory
outputs.description: Set of requested unit IDs found in passed committed history records; this signal does not establish shipment.

errors.name: Feature documentation read failure
errors.description: Unexpected feature-document read failures can throw; malformed historical evidence is ignored by the history lookup.
